semantic.justification: The existing Sidebar root now owns the 13 local key codes inspected in SidebarDockingWindow::EventNotify after child widget handling, regardless of modifiers. It stops document accelerator lookup and cancels unhandled browser defaults while retaining editable widget defaults and button Enter activation. Literal owned key/modifier cases and actual Writer clipboard-port/model/no-dispatch checks cover this bounded routing contract; desktop/mobile browser cases cover selected-document safety, real local editing and activation. Other keys retain the existing frame fallback. Native DesignerDialog/styles handling, complete accelerator precedence/platform/LOK/input eligibility, floating/mouse docking, other decks and full Sidebar/native parity remain unverified. Save/open/recovery exceptions are unchanged.
